run_pimh_chain: run a particle independent Metropolis-Hastings chain for a given number of samples using particle_metropolis_loop
accept_reject_particle: accept or reject a proposed particle state based on log normalizer estimates using particle_metropolis_step
build_pimh_sampler: build a particle independent Metropolis-Hastings sampler that proposes particles and records expectations over iterations
review_metropolis_step: review the particle_metropolis_step function to understand the log-space acceptance probability logic
refactor_pimh_loop: refactor the particle_metropolis_loop to support custom proposal strategies or different recording callbacks
